MLB considered it necessary to amend the size of the strike zone when criticisms were received from players.

A ball is considered a strike when the batter does not hit it and it crosses through a **35** ________ extending approximately from the batter's knee to his chest. In the past, **36** ________ over strike calls were not uncommon, but today everyone accepts the complete ban on pushing or shoving the umpire.
